Learning Objectives
• Explain the thermodynamic process (hydrophobic effect) driving 
macromolecular assembly in the case of lipids self assembling into 
membranes. 
To do this you will need to be able to:
• Explain how fatty acid structure and the hydrophobic effect determines how 
lipids will self-assemble as micelles or bilayers when mixed with water.
• Recognize the diversity of lipids.
• Using glycerophospholipids as an example of a lipid, describe basic types of 
interactions among lipids and between lipids and membrane proteins.
• Describe the amphipathic nature of phospholipids, and identify which non-
covalent interactions will likely form when phospholipids are mixed with 
water.
